players.product: Ultrapure water supply systems for semiconductor fabs (wafer and chip cleaning), wastewater treatment and recycling systems, ultrapure ion exchange resins and water treatment chemicals for electronics

quarterly_data.signal: First half to September 30, 2025 (semi-annual report): orders received JPY 100,281 million (+8.1% YoY), net sales JPY 82,793 million (+11.4%), operating profit JPY 17,378 million (+51.4%), ordinary profit JPY 17,349 million (+45.2%), profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 11,528 million (+41.7%); order backlog JPY 124,073 million (-9.9%). Management states demand for leading-edge semiconductors related to generative AI kept growing and AI-related capex stayed active, while demand for non-leading-edge semiconductors such as power semiconductors stayed weak as EV growth slowed; general industry and social infrastructure were firm, centred on maintenance demand.
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 82,793 million (+11.4%); operating profit JPY 17,378 million (+51.4%); order backlog JPY 124,073 million (-9.9%)

quarterly_data.signal: Segments, first half to September 30, 2025 (semi-annual report): Water Treatment Engineering orders JPY 87,294 million (+8.9%) on large semiconductor projects won in Taiwan, the US and Europe and strong solutions (equipment-ownership services, maintenance); sales JPY 70,549 million (+14.0%) as semiconductor plant projects in Japan and Taiwan progressed well and nuclear power plant solution sales rose; operating profit JPY 15,771 million (+60.9%) on higher electronics sales, the higher-margin solutions mix, profitable plant projects and margin improvement. Performance Products orders JPY 12,987 million (+3.2%), sales JPY 12,243 million (-1.6%) - compact pure / ultrapure water units grew and water treatment chemicals, filters and functional materials were generally strong, offset by trimming low-margin food transactions; operating profit JPY 1,607 million (-4.2%) as higher personnel and R&D costs outweighed better margins. R&D expenses in the half were JPY 1,587 million.
